name: Savaya
description: a luxury cliffside beach club and nightclub located in Uluwatu, Bali, known for its stunning ocean views and world-class electronic music events. It has been ranked the #1 club in Asia for 2024 and 2025, and the top club in the world, attracting major international DJs and artists. The venue is a destination for both daytime relaxation and nighttime parties, featuring an immersive atmosphere and high-end hospitality.
